subject: Implementing the grammar of graphics in Shiny

messages.author: 4114912dbf9e2d36
messages.subject: Implementing the grammar of graphics in Shiny
parts: I want to bring ggplot2 to the general public who don't know R, and I think Shiny is the perfect platform for that. Basically I want to create a UI that would pass the parameters needed for ggplot2. That way, the non-technical user can create the same plots but not need to know R. So before I start reinventing the wheel, I want to know if anyone has done anything similar or if people want to join me in my quest.
